title: SaaS UI lab 3 (source of the round-3 SaaS UI templates)
summary: The 7 comps the round-3 SaaS UI templates were built and verified in: pricing plans, browser window load, submit to success, kanban drag, integrations hub, zoom to card and review card.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 SaaS UI template working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a product video, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing it.

comps: SU Zoom focus (150 f, full app frame)

carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: Each comp except SU Zoom focus has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg". SU Zoom focus is extracted whole (it is a full app frame).
Clip ids are unique per comp (spp_, sbw_, sss_, skd_, sih_, szf_, srv_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/saas_ui_lab3.py writes the comps with every move baked as keys (no presets to apply); open the file and edit.save.
Parented parts: card contents ride their card, and in SU Zoom focus every object rides the App canvas (the camera).
Lint: every comp 0 errors / 0 warnings (notes only).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
